title: Custom 384-Well Plate PCR Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired protocol parameters (e.g., number of samples, transfer scheme) in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files (.json extensions) to upload.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware
Select the .json labware files and confirm upload

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script file (.py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck as shown in the deck map, placing the custom cooling rack with strip tubes and the 384‑well plate for up to 16 samples.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette following the standard calibration workflow (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
